## Current team members

```{r}
#| output: asis
library(googlesheets4)

gs4_deauth()

people <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/154vEZLxSaBz1Vc6_8za9k0ymMbjI3GKMWypRVown7Lc/edit?gid=0#gid=0",
) |>
  transform(full_name = paste(first_name, last_name)) 


make_icon <- function(href, icon_class, label) {
  sprintf(
    '<a href="%s" title="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="person-icon"><i class="bi %s"></i></a>',
    href,
    label,
    icon_class
  )
}

make_card <- function(row) {
  icons <- character(0)

  if (!is.na(row$email_address) && nzchar(row$email_address)) {
    icons <- c(
      icons,
      make_icon(paste0("mailto:", row$email_address), "bi-envelope", "Email")
    )
  }
  if (!is.na(row$personal_website) && nzchar(row$personal_website)) {
    if (!startsWith(row$personal_website, "http")) {
      row$personal_website <- paste0("https://", row$personal_website)
    }
    icons <- c(icons, make_icon(row$personal_website, "bi-globe", "Website"))
  }
  if (!is.na(row$bluesky_username) && nzchar(row$bluesky_username)) {
    icons <- c(
      icons,
      make_icon(
        paste0(
          "https://bsky.app/profile/",
          row$bluesky_username,
          ".bsky.social"
        ),
        "bi-bluesky",
        "Bluesky"
      )
    )
  }
  if (!is.na(row$github_username) && nzchar(row$github_username)) {
    icons <- c(
      icons,
      make_icon(
        paste0("https://github.com/", row$github_username),
        "bi-github",
        "GitHub"
      )
    )
  }
  if (!is.na(row$linkedin_username) && nzchar(row$linkedin_username)) {
    if (!startsWith(row$linkedin_username, "http")) {
      row$linkedin_username <- paste0("https://", row$linkedin_username)
    }
    icons <- c(
      icons,
      make_icon(row$linkedin_username, "bi-linkedin", "LinkedIn")
    )
  }

  icons_html <- if (length(icons) > 0) {
    paste0('<div class="person-icons">', paste(icons, collapse = ""), "</div>")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  affiliation_html <- if (!is.na(row$affiliation) && nzchar(row$affiliation)) {
    paste0('<p class="person-affiliation">', row$affiliation, "</p>")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  path_to_picture <- paste0("../../_img/profiles/", row$first_name, ".png")
  if (!file.exists(path_to_picture)) {
    path_to_picture <- "../../_img/profiles/default.png"
  }

  paste0(
    '<div class="person-card">',
    '<img src="',
    path_to_picture,
    '" class="person-avatar" alt="',
    row$full_name,
    '">',
    '<div class="person-info">',
    '<h3>',
    row$full_name,
    "</h3>",
    affiliation_html,
    icons_html,
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

cards <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(people)),
  function(i) make_card(people[i, ]),
  character(1)
)
cat('<div class="person-grid">\n', paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
```

## Former team members

```{r}
#| output: asis

contributors <- data.frame(
  first_name = c("Christopher D.", "Kilian", "Alessandro", "Sofía", "Lucas", "Mark", "Bruna"), 
  last_name = c("Dean", "Eichenseer", "Alfio Chiarenza", "Galván", "Buffan", "Nikolic", "Farina"), 
  email_address = "", 
  personal_website = "", 
  linkedin_username = "", 
  affiliation = "", 
  github_username = "", 
  bluesky_username = ""
) |> 
  transform(full_name = paste(first_name, last_name)) 

contributors_cards <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(contributors)),
  function(i) make_card(contributors[i, ]),
  character(1)
)

cat('<div class="person-grid">\n', paste(contributors_cards, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
```
